DAVE.note: deliberately DUST-less; the sponsorship suite asserts it

issues.title: Shipped preprod pre-seed bundle was unusable
issues.detail: Restoring from the bundle at height 2203416 put the wallet in an infinite retry loop: 'values inserted non-linearly into zswap/dust commitment tree'. unshielded completed (no commitment tree) while shielded and dust never did. dedup.ts did not catch it because it filters by event id whereas these are commitment-tree positions.
issues.resolution: Added `preseed:cut --from-genesis`, which skips restore/dedup entirely, and re-cut the bundle at height 2684544.

issues.title: One RPC failure during the aggregate sweep
issues.detail: hello-world failed with 'FATAL: Unable to initialize the API: WebSocket is not connected' against wss://rpc.preprod.midnight.network, after ~37 transactions in ~15 minutes. Passed on re-run with identical code.
issues.followUp: Root `test:preprod` uses `yarn workspaces foreach`, which bails on first failure; this one flake blocked four suites that had never run. Consider per-example retry or --no-bail.

openFollowUps: Per-wallet state cache: every run re-restores from the bundle. A per-wallet serializeState/restore round-trip needs no isSeedable guard and would sidestep bundle staleness.
Make the root test:preprod aggregate resilient to transient node-RPC failures.
